introHtml: Red tape measures stand out on a job site or in a toolbox, making your brand easy to spot. Whether you need compact 5-foot mini rounds for giveaways or durable 10-foot translucent models for contractors, these red promotional tape measures offer high visibility and daily utility. Imprint your logo on the case or blade for repeated exposure every time a worker reaches for a measurement.
